h: CCB reportedly reviewing overseas-asset claims against Peter Obi, Bukola Saraki and David Mark
p: The Code of Conduct Bureau is reportedly reviewing claims from the Panama and Pandora Papers leaks about undisclosed foreign assets linked to several current and former politicians, including Peter Obi, Bukola Saraki and David Mark. The bureau is said to have described the process as confidential. Being under review does not mean any wrongdoing has been proven.
more: Others named in the reports include Stella Oduah and James Ibori.
The bureau has declined to give details.
The reports come about 80 days before the election.
